title: Echassier - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Echassier in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A stilt-legged Nevron. Fire lands and nothing is resisted.

sections.title: How to Beat the Echassier
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Fire is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.
